routes.name: Permiso Especial de Ingreso para artistas extranjeros (PEI Artistas)

note: El Salvador, read on the General Directorate of Migration and Foreigners' service pages (migracion.gob.sv) on 2026-10-30. A person or company in El Salvador that has hired a foreign artist (music, theatre, singing, dance, circus, shows, radio or television) asks online for the artist's Special Entry Permit, with the Directorate of Public Shows' resolution, the artists' list and travel itineraries; the migration fee is US$100 for an artist from outside Central America (US$60 for Central Americans; US$100 kept, the dollar being the country's currency), and the resolution is notified within 5 working days. The hirer applies from El Salvador for an artist who may be abroad ('either'); the permit is for the engagement (work for the sponsor); its length isn't stated. The temporary residence with authorisation to work (form F3), its extension (F18) and permanent residence (F32) are listed, but their forms are on a third-party file host and weren't read, so their terms and fees aren't kept; naturalisation isn't written.

sources.title: DGME El Salvador, Solicitud y pago en línea de Permiso Especial de Ingreso para artistas extranjeros (publicado el 15-08-2024)
sources.said: Este trámite migratorio dirigido a toda persona natural o jurídica en la República de El Salvador que ha contratado a un artista extranjero ... Envía la resolución y constancia emitida por la Dirección General de Espectáculos Públicos. ... Realiza el Pago por la tasa migratoria de Permiso Especial de Ingreso para Artistas centroamericanos ($60.00) y no centroamericanos ($100.00). ... En el plazo de 5 días hábiles, se notificará la resolución correspondiente a favor de los artistas extranjeros
